objects.description: [Netwalker](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0457)'s PowerShell script has been obfuscated with multiple layers including base64 and hexadecimal encoding and XOR-encryption, as well as obfuscated PowerShell functions and variables.(Citation: TrendMicro Netwalker May 2020)(Citation: Sophos Netwalker May 2020)
objects.description_fa: اسکریپت PowerShell [Netwalker](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0457) با چندین لایه از جمله base64 و رمزگذاری هگزا دسیمال و رمزگذاری XOR، و همچنین توابع و متغیرهای مبهم PowerShell مبهم شده است. (Citation: TrendMicro Netwalker May 2020) (Citation: Sophos Netwalker May 2020)
